preconditions.text: In the next epoch's window, voters call reset to reclaim bribes, bringing totalWeight to zero.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.
evidence: 1. Voters call `reset` in the next epoch’s window to reclaim bribes, bringing `totalWeight` to zero.

When every voter has reset (`totalWeight == 0`), the transfer `HYBR::transferFrom(minter, GaugeManager, amount)` still executes, yet `index` remains unchanged. Later, `_updateForAfterDistribution` calculates each gauge’s share from `index - supplyIndex[gauge]`. Because that delta is zero, `claimable[gauge]` never increases, and the freshly minted HYBR is effectively orphaned inside `GaugeManager`.

safety.text: A minted epoch emission must be accounted to the reward flow (gauges' claimable) rather than left stranded in GaugeManager.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.
evidence: When every voter has reset (`totalWeight == 0`), the transfer `HYBR::transferFrom(minter, GaugeManager, amount)` still executes, yet `index` remains unchanged. Later, `_updateForAfterDistribution` calculates each gauge’s share from `index - supplyIndex[gauge]`. Because that delta is zero, `claimable[gauge]` never increases, and the freshly minted HYBR is effectively orphaned inside `GaugeManager`.

The PoC shows that with current parameters the first weekly emission mints ~2.47M HYBR into `GaugeManager`, leaves `claimable[gauge]` at zero, and later distributions do not touch the stranded balance. There is no refund or recovery mechanism, so every occurrence permanently removes an entire emission cycle from the reward flow. This is a protocol-level loss affecting all liquidity providers and voters, so the severity is **High**.
